in_marathi.name: Aranab
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the sky
in_marathi.long_meaning: Aranab हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Aranab is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'Lord of the sky'. In Hindu mythology, Aranab is the name of Indra, the god of rain and thunder. Aranab is a powerful and majestic name, evoking images of strength, protection, and divine blessings.
